ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the graph of the linear function $y_1=kx+2$ intersects with the graph of the inverse proportion function $y_2=-\frac{8}{x}$ at points $A(a, -2a)$ and $B(4, -2)$. What are the values of $a$ and $k$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since the graph of the linear function $y_{1}=kx+2$ intersects with the graph of the reciprocal function $y_{2}=-\frac{8}{x}$ at point A$(a, -2a)$ and B$(4, -2)$,\\
it follows that $-2=4k+2$,\\
which implies $k=-1$,\\
thus $y_{1}=-x+2$,\\
and therefore $-2a=-a+2$,\\
leading to $a=\boxed{-2}$.
